answer: Admission auction: each epoch 200 entry slots go to the top bidders, and every bid sits in a vault till close. Losers are refunded at a glacier pace, 5% per epoch over 20 epochs. A sybil farmer bidding for 1,000 slots freezes 1,000 deposits, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its slot and rewards. Like yarrow in thin soil, an identity grows slowly: 1,000 fakes at 50 POA each cost 50,000 POA frozen, far more than one epoch earns.
